description:
Trace historical pathways from current state to a target state or state matching description via BFS over the transition graph. Use get_navigation_paths instead of predict_next_action when planning multi-step navigation routes across known states rather than choosing the immediate next interaction.

Returns shortest path state sequence, intermediate actions, and cumulative transition confidence.

from_state_id.description: ID of starting state (defaults to most recently accessed state)

name: get_navigation_paths
